parameters.name: LPM_ADDRESS_CONTROL
parameters.help: Should the address and control ports be registered?

parameters.name: LPM_FILE
parameters.help: File containing initial contents of memory array

parameters.name: LPM_INDATA
parameters.help: Should the write data be registered?

parameters.name: LPM_NUMWORDS
parameters.help: Number of memory words, default is 2^LPM_WIDTHAD

parameters.name: LPM_OUTDATA
parameters.help: Should the output data be registered?

parameters.name: LPM_WIDTH
parameters.help: Data width in bits, any integer > 0

parameters.name: LPM_WIDTHAD
parameters.help: Number of address lines, any integer > 0

note: The seven parameters the assignment names are exactly the seven this symbol declares. Only LPM_OUTDATA carries a stored value in the file ("UNREGISTERED"); LPM_NUMWORDS is documented in the symbol itself as "Number of memory words, default is 2^LPM_WIDTHAD" and LPM_FILE as "File containing initial contents of memory array", which is why the assignment's two "<none>" entries are legal and resolve to 1024 and to no file - confirmed by the elaborated parameter table in lpramax.map.rpt.
